title: Enterprise Agent Wars: Who Plays Switzerland?
excerpt: Enterprise AI vendors are positioning themselves as neutral orchestration platforms while aggressively expanding their own agent ecosystems. The vendors best positioned to play Switzerland are the ones nobody's talking about yet.
post_draft:
Who really owns your AI agents?

We're watching a fascinating game play out: major enterprise AI vendors claim to be neutral orchestration platforms while quietly building their own agent armies.

The thing is, the vendors winning this war might not be the household names you'd expect. The real Switzerland moves are happening in the shadows, and most people aren't paying attention yet.

In our latest piece, we break down the vendor positioning strategies that actually matter. You'll learn why "neutrality" is becoming the new competitive advantage, which players are genuinely committed to openness, and where the real consolidation risks hide.

This matters for your architecture decisions today.

Read the full article to see who's actually playing it straight—and who's just talking about it.
